decisions.reason: Changing the date field's help-label text does not alter the requirement to preserve Title field formatting.
The source specifies a date-field help label and does not change how placeholder text clears when a field is clicked.
The selected date-field help text does not resolve or modify the separate requirement for grey visual input cues.
The source changes label wording only and does not select or modify the mechanism used for robust standard text placeholders.
The date-field help-label wording has no effect on the checklist control type or behavior.
The source concerns a date-field help label and does not change the Bestyrelsesmode dropdown control.
Although the label refers to inserting a date, it does not change the calendar-style date input method.
The date-field help-label text does not modify the required theme color palette.
The source does not concern Enter-key behavior or automatic continuation of structured lists.
The date-field help-label wording does not alter bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, or variants.
The source does not change manual line-break behavior after legacy content is pasted.
The Danish date-field help-label text does not modify style prefixes, style-name language, applicability, or covered style categories.
